articles.author: HeartBeam, Inc.
articles.headline: HeartBeam Receives FDA Breakthrough Device Designation for Heart Attack Assessment
articles.summary: HeartBeam announces FDA Breakthrough Device Designation for its at-home heart-attack assessment technology. The designation supports prioritized regulatory interaction; it is distinct from marketing clearance for that indication, approval of efficacy or guaranteed Medicare coverage.
